asset.name: Chart
asset.description: The responsive chart framework standardizing axes, legends, tooltips, value formatting, selection, theme integration, keyboard summaries, and every generic data state around a pluggable rendering engine.

requires.reason: Scales, palettes, spacing, and motion resolve to declared ramps.
Labels and values use the shared text styles.
Loading, empty, partial, stale, error, and offline presentation are delegated rather than reimplemented.
Axis values and tooltips are formatted for the active locale.
Responsive sizing measures without forcing layout on every render.

rationale: The framework carries the parts that are wrong in most chart usage: the accessible textual equivalent, the empty and partial states, and colour that survives high-contrast mode. The engine underneath is replaceable and deliberately not in the base bundle.
